Telephone No. for Service Support. 8. Minimum Average annual turnover of the bidder for the last three financial year must be 6,00,000. 9. Contract may be extended/renewed for a further period of 1 year on the same rates, terms and conditio ns, subject to satisfactory performance of the service provider and mutual consent. .
